proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection { mode: "any" }
proposed_widenings.justification: Enthrall targets 'creatures of your choice that you can see within range' with no stated count limit. The current TargetSelection union only has 'one' and 'choose_up_to' (the latter requiring a SlotScaling<number> count). An uncapped multi-target mode is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: RollKind: "ability_check"
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail effect is a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks. RollKind currently only covers 'attack_roll' and 'saving_throw'. Skill/ability checks are a third mechanically distinct roll kind required to describe this effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a target has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect: ModifyRollNumericEffect (using v4 atom modify_roll_numeric)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Effect type used in ActivationPhase.onFail is restricted to DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The Enthrall on-fail result is a numeric roll modifier (modify_roll_numeric in v4 taxonomy), which is unreachable from the save_gate branch. Effect needs a new variant that exposes modify_roll_numeric with a RollKind array and a signed integer delta.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a target has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.

notes: All three v4 atoms needed already exist (target, save_gate, modify_roll_numeric). No new atom is required. The gaps are entirely surface-shape: (1) TargetSelection lacks an uncapped mode, (2) RollKind lacks ability_check, (3) Effect in ActivationPhase cannot express a roll penalty. The auto-success clause ('any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds') is a filter on save eligibility — it is not itself a new atom, but would need to be noted as a targeting predicate in the surface (possibly via a new AnchoredFilter-style predicate on the save_gate attachment, or documented as an authoring note). This secondary concern does not change the classification.
